svg.title: Distributed Cache · financial quorum path
svg.desc: A 500k-user distributed cache for balanced financial reads and writes, with explicit request routing, virtual-node placement, physical cache-server replicas, read/write quorums, HIT/MISS paths, write-through, Cassandra consistency, eviction, and monitoring.

text.tspan: Spread reads and writes across app instances
Library inside the application / API service
Place key · select replicas · await quorums
First token: vB2 → Cache Shard B
R + W > N · tolerates one failed server
Coalesce misses for the same key
R=2 / W=2 · no stale single-copy fallback
CL=QUORUM: two of three must respond
Balanced reads / writes · strong consistency for financial keys
No client sees a value older than the last acknowledged write
KEY PLACEMENT · HASH → CLOCKWISE SUCCESSOR → SHARD
CACHE SERVERS · THREE REPLICAS · OVERLAPPING QUORUMS
